messages:
maya: quick heads-up — ran onboarding smoke for acorn-embed-v2 int6 on staging. shortseq recall@1 down ~6% vs acorn-v1. anyone around to triage? :eyes:
Sam: on it. can you paste the eval command / link?
maya: ran `python eval/recall.py --model acorn-embed-v2 --quant int6 --queries shortseq --k 1 --index prod-k10`
maya: results snippet:
```
baseline (acorn-v1, fp16): recall@1 = 0.842
acorn-embed-v2 int6: recall@1 = 0.792
delta = -0.050 (~5.9% relative)
```
Zoe: thanks. did you run per-channel vs per-tensor quant? which backend?
maya: int6-perchannel via onnxruntime + custom kernel. same config we used for yesterday's mini-bench.
Liam: could be quant artifacts or preprocessing mismatch. quick checks: (1) L2 norm distribution shift, (2) whitening drift, (3) tokenization change.
Sam: copying norms now. `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-evals/acorn/v2/shortseq/norms.csv - | head -n 10` shows mean norm 3.12 vs baseline 3.09 — small but maybe relevant.
Zoe: run a quick nearest-neighbor idflip check: `python eval/idflip.py --old acorn-v1 --new acorn-embed-v2 --queries shortseq --k 1 --sample 1000`
eval-bot: idflip job queued (job id ej-5732). ETA ~3m.
Liam: also plot UMAP of 500 anchors. sometimes quant collapses local topology even if global stats look ok. can someone run `scripts/umap_plot.py --model acorn-embed-v2 --quant int6 --sample anchors500` and upload png?
maya: running now. uploading to https://console.redwood/embeds/5732/umap.png :point_up:
maya: umap looks like slight compression in tight clusters, some anchors overlapping.
Sam: infra-bot reports throughput and kv cache diff: `infra-bot: deploy acorn-v2-int6 staging succeeded. latency +2ms p50, mem -12%`
Liam: that could be harmless. next: try int8-perchannel and int6-pertensor to isolate quant scheme. if int8 matches baseline then int6 quantizer needs calibration tweak.
Zoe: good plan. i'm kicking off int8-perchannel run.
Sam: also bisect recent quant commits — we changed calibration seed two commits ago. bisect ticket #7245 created.
maya: action items: Zoe run int8-perchannel, Sam run idflip full and bisect commits, Liam look at whitening parity and small preprocessing diffs. i'll file a short postmortem if we confirm regression.
Zoe: int8-perchannel recall@1 = 0.838 (within noise of baseline).
maya: ok that points to int6 quantizer.
Liam: hypothesis: per-channel scaling with signed truncation introduced bias for short sequences. try symmetric quant vs asymmetric.
maya: assigning pairwise: @Sam please attach the bisect results here when ready. @Liam can you propose a small calibration fix? i'll hold staging until we validate. :thumbsup:
Sam: will do. starting bisect now, will ping with the first failing commit.
eval-bot: idflip job ej-5732 complete. idflip rate = 3.8% (baseline 2.0%). full logs: s3://redwood-evals/acorn/v2/idflip/ej-5732.log
maya: thanks — that matches recall drop. good detective work team.
Liam: quick mitigation idea: ship int8 for now and mark int6 as experimental with a flag in routing policy. pushing that to ops channel after we confirm.
maya: agreed. i'll update rollout policy. meeting in 30m if needed.
